gap.question: Are there any recent human studies (2024-2026) that validate strain-specific immune mechanisms (e.g., DC maturation by a specific bacterium) in solid tumor patients beyond correlation?
success_criteria: Identify at least one prospective human study linking a specific bacterial strain (not just genus) to a measured immune mechanism (e.g., DC cytokine profile, T cell clonality) in ICI-treated solid tumor patients.
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
